entry.title: [BIP Draft] bip39() Descriptor Key Expression
entry.summary:
A new proposal has been introduced to enhance output script descriptors by incorporating a key expression that directly supports mnemonic-based wallet recovery. Mnemonics, while widely used in wallet creation and backup, alone do not provide all the necessary information for robust wallet restoration. Additional data, such as derivation paths and script types, are crucial for accurate recovery. Descriptors serve this purpose by encapsulating these critical details, thereby improving interoperability and reliability across wallet software.
The proposed standard seeks to streamline the integration of English BIP39 mnemonics with optional passphrases into descriptor-based workflows. By representing the mnemonic and passphrase directly within a descriptor—using syntax like wpkh(bip39([word1, .., wordN], "passphrase")/84h/0h/0h/0/*)—wallets can derive the BIP32 master extended private key and manage key expressions, including those requiring multiple keys, various derivation paths, and complex multipath setups. This approach aligns mnemonic-based wallet imports with descriptor standards, enabling more consistent and secure recovery processes.
Further details and the complete draft can be reviewed in the [pull request](https://github.com/polespinasa/bips/pull/2). Additionally, an initial implementation is available for testing on top of Bitcoin Core at [this repository](https://github.com/polespinasa/bitcoin/pull/8). Feedback and comments are encouraged, either directly on the pull request or through discussion channels.
